title: Automated Portfolio Rebalancing for Boutique Wealth Managers
business: Boutique wealth management firms managing diversified portfolios across global markets.
problem: Manual reconciliation of portfolio allocations against target models is time-consuming and prone to human error when adjusting for shifting market conditions.
solution: The Claude Interactive Brokers connector enables natural language queries to retrieve current portfolio allocations and generate structured trade instructions for review, bridging the gap between analytical intent and execution.
steps: Authenticate the IBKR connector within the Claude environment to establish secure read-access to account data.
Query current portfolio allocations using the get_portfolio_allocation tool to identify deviations from the firm's target model.
Request Claude to draft trade instructions based on identified imbalances using the get_order_instructions tool.
Review the generated trade instructions within the IBKR platform interface, ensuring all parameters align with compliance requirements before final submission.
outcome: Wealth managers achieve a more responsive rebalancing workflow, allowing for rapid adjustment of holdings based on real-time data without manual spreadsheet calculations.
limitation: The connector acts as an intermediary for drafting, not execution; Claude never submits orders directly to the market, requiring a manual review step for every transaction.

questions.question: In Automated Portfolio Rebalancing for Boutique Wealth Managers, what is the primary role of the Claude connector in addressing the problem of manual reconciliation?

It replaces the need for an IBKR account entirely.
It performs high-frequency trading based on market sentiment.
